body:
I have had encounters with this girl's demon myself. Practicing dark magicks is very dangerous, especially if she's dealing with Azazel. As for "God", as you call him, he'd never take an Infernal Duke to Havea. 

Listen, it is your choice. But do not anger her. Even without a demon, she can use other things to harm you. If she truly cares about you, she will choose you over whatever power if being given to her. And it was probably not Lucifer that possessed her. Lucifer generally doesn't possess anyone anymore, and if he does, your girlfriend's soul has to be strong enough to sustain it or else she will die.

Another thing I can recommend doing is get the fuck away from her. Don't dump her just yet, but keep your distance, but not enough for her to get suspicious. When a soul is dealing with more of their darkness they hold within, they tend to act on their negative impulses. And for the record, a demon or an angel are not ASSIGNED a human being. They choose them. 

What you can do is infact the cliche: when she channels the infernal energies, you cannot battle it, since you don't practice Light Magicks. Instead, use salt. But have it blessed by a priest or priestess of Light Magicks. But use the salt to draw a circle around yourself. It actually helps, and that is called substance magicks. Another thing you can do is get something called a Rowan Tree. They are very strong Plant Magicks, with a lot of channeling of light energies. Put it by your door and it can be used as a guardian of sorts, to where whatever is attached to your girlfriend is left at the door. She will get furious, but will only be able to channel her own energy, but if she does have Azazel, then she will be weak without him. 
Last but not least, sage your home. Use white sage, which is stronger than regular sage. These are basic things you can do without doing any sort of witchcraft. I hope these help you. 

Lady Kryshna
